orchestrator_independent_checks: R3 fuselage.stl sliced at x = 7, 10, 15, 20, 25, 28 m by a separate script: crown 6.0900, belly 1.9500, half-width 1.9741-1.9748, rho 0.497-0.505 (band-mean estimate, resolution about +-0.005), consistent with the worker's parabola-fit rho 0.499988

L1_r3_frame.note: measured values only; no claim is made here about the R3 section shape between the side and crown/belly points (R6 found flat crown/belly clips in R3)

L2_normalisation.rule: per contract 03 M2; reproduce from the raw trace (SHA above) with r7_profiles.py; the reproduced scales must match these to 1e-6 relative, else STOP

L3_knot_rule_and_fit.rule_text: feature knots at the ends of straight stretches >= 1 m, remaining knots by equidistribution of (|y''| + 2e-3)^(2/5)
L3_knot_rule_and_fit.continuity: C2 everywhere inside the fit domain. NO C0/multiple knot at the windshield corner (contract 03 M3 requires C2; the 9.6 mm crown residual there is inside the side band)
L3_knot_rule_and_fit.reproduction_check: phase B refits from the raw trace with the locked knots; residual max per curve must match r7-measure.json to 1e-6 m (w 4.6247 mm, zc 9.6361 mm, zb 2.7167 mm), else STOP
L3_knot_rule_and_fit.no_spurious_extrema: the fit must not create a local extremum that the trace does not have (evaluated at 1 mm spacing; trace extrema of prominence < 0.5 mm ignored). Any knot interval that does is replaced by Fritsch-Carlson C1 on the same knots (contract 03 M3 / 02b); every replaced interval is recorded. The worker's 'overshoot_intervals_over_0.5mm' list (data-envelope test per knot interval, nose x < 2.6 m) must be re-examined under this definition and reported
L3_knot_rule_and_fit.printed_extremes_renormalisation: after fitting, w(x) is multiplied by 3.95 / max(w_fit) and z_c, z_b are scaled about z = 4.0200 by 4.14 / max(z_c - z_b)_fit, so the printed maxima are reproduced exactly; each factor must lie in [0.9995, 1.0005], else STOP. No plateau/constant pinning (it would add exactly axis-parallel lines). Measured fit maxima before correction: w 3.949942 m

L4_ring_rule.vertex_placement: vertices exactly at crown (y = 0), belly (y = 0) and both max-width points; equal arc length per quadrant (32 segments)
L4_ring_rule.spacing: meridian edge length h(x) = min(sqrt(8 * 0.001 / kappa), 3 * P / 128, 0.6 m), |dh/dx| <= 0.18, marching from both ends, equal steps on the plateau 12-28 m (as r7_rings.py, measured 268 rings, growth ratio max 1.2185)
L4_ring_rule.forced_stations: a ring at argmax w(x) and a ring at argmax (z_c - z_b)(x) after L3 renormalisation, inserted with the same growth limit (<= 1.25); the station list is written to the attempt receipt

locked.L5_closures: nose and tail per 02b: 1 mm linear closure bands; the tail is blunt (traced 0.405 x 0.391 m, R3 0.401 x 0.377 m), closed with the 02b cap, whose rim is a declared feature line for the dihedral gate (as in R3/R6)

L6_own_curve_deviation.method: two-sided and dense: (a) surface -> analytic: every triangle sampled at the same 7 barycentric points as dense_component_deviation.py, exact point-to-implicit-surface distance by local minimisation (not the first-order F/|grad F|); (b) analytic -> surface: analytic surface sampled at >= 4x the ring density in x and >= 4x the 128 ring points in angle, exact trimesh closest_point. Closure bands included.
L6_own_curve_deviation.basis: phase A point-sample estimate 1.742 mm (x 3.44 m), ring sagitta 0.654 mm
L6_own_curve_deviation.on_exceedance: FAIL, reported to the orchestrator; the limit is not re-locked

L7_outline_band.basis: root-sum-square of the measured drawing-consistency components (top: L/R asymmetry per edge about the best-fit centreline 0.0131, tip-to-centreline 0.0081, y-scale spread 0.0111, top-vs-side length 0.0154; side: z-scale spread 0.0410, tip 0.0081, length 0.0154). The linear sums 0.048 / 0.064 m are NOT used (the tighter RSS values are locked)
L7_outline_band.top_view_comparison: candidate half-width silhouette (max |y| per x slice of the tessellated surface) vs EACH traced edge (upper and lower) measured about the best-fit centreline (shift 0.0068 m), per edge, every trace sample; also reported (not gated): vs the drawn centreline
L7_outline_band.side_view_comparison: candidate crown and belly silhouette (max/min z per x slice) vs the normalised, z-offset traced crown and belly, every trace sample
L7_outline_band.excluded_from_gate: the hidden-line bridges with no drawn line (crown x 26.563-27.162 m, belly x 15.703-24.782 m) and the closure bands (x < 0.001, x > 44.509); the bridges are a declared straight-line ASSUMPTION and their deviation is reported separately

L8_A5_root_embedment_margin_m.basis: side band linear sum 0.0644 + aft fit residual 0.0027 + z offset 0.0023 + tessellation estimate 0.0017 = 0.0711, rounded up
L8_A5_root_embedment_margin_m.verdict_before_surface: PASS for all three (contract 03 A5 pre-surface condition met)
L8_A5_root_embedment_margin_m.phase_B: re-measured on the tessellated R7 fuselage and reported; same margin
L8_A5_root_embedment_margin_m.labels: the wing depth is measured to the bridged (assumed) belly line; the crown bulge where the fin leading edge meets the crown (x 33.6-41.3 m, +0.042 m) may be a fillet line in the drawing (R3 has the same bulge)

L9_step0_barrel.rule: contract 03 step 0, mirroring the production choices: section = two half-ellipses with L1 rho, w = 3.95 m, height 4.14 m, crown and belly exactly constant (so crown/belly/max-width ring edges are exactly x-parallel, as on the R7 plateau), N = 128 with L4 vertex placement, plateau ring spacing of L4, length >= 10 m, L5-style 1 mm closure caps
L9_step0_barrel.variant_B0b: the same barrel plus, at one end, a >= 3 m linear taper of w and height to the traced blunt tail size (0.405 x 0.391 m) closed with the L5 cap; added by the orchestrator as a stricter test of the tail closure
L9_step0_barrel.pass: surfaceCheck v1912 0 AND locator 0 AND PyMeshLab 0 on both variants; otherwise STOP and report, no R7 fuselage under 03/03a
